info.name: CMES Staff/HR API
info.description: Every Staff/HR endpoint plus the Budget & Treasury Finance API calls the integration uses. Pick an environment (Azure or Local). Requests save the ids they create in collection variables (newStaffNumber, requisitionNumber, fundingRequestId, ...) for the requests after them. In Development (demo mode) no token is needed.

item.name: 13 Scenarios (run with Collection Runner)
item.description: Run a scenario folder top to bottom with the Collection Runner. Each request saves the ids the next one needs.

item.name: Hire funded by Budget (end to end)
item.description: Creates a funding request in Budget's test system and approves it.

exec: pm.test('Our request is there and pending', () => { const r = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('fundingRequestId')); pm.expect(r).to.exist; pm.expect(r.reason).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('requisitionNumber')); pm.expect(r.status).to.be.oneOf([0, 'Pending']); });
